pageData.heading: Loan Against Property
pageData.para:
Unlock the Power of Your Property!
Get a Loan Against Property at Competitive Rates with Zero Hassles!

cardData.title: Secured Loan
cardData.para: A loan where you pledge your property as collateral to borrow funds. It allows individuals or businesses to unlock the value of their owned property without selling it.

cardData.title: High Loan Amount
cardData.para: Get a loan of up to 60-70% of the market value of the property, depending on the lender's policies.

cardData.title: Usage Flexibility
cardData.para:
The borrowed amount can be used for various purposes, such as:

  • Expanding a business
  • Paying for higher education
  • Medical emergencies
  • Debt consolidation
  • Funding big events like weddings or travel
  • Unexpected expenses or business losses

cardData.title: Competitive Interest Rates
cardData.para: Generally lower than personal loans or credit card debts, making it a cost-effective borrowing option.

benefits.heading: Benefits
benefits.secPara:
• Lower Interest Rates: 9% to 12% p.a.
  • No Restrictions on Usage
  • Higher Loan Amounts: Up to 60-70% of the property's market value.
  • Flexible Repayment Options: Loan repayment terms from 5 to 15 years.

cardData.title: Eligibility Criteria
cardData.para:
• Who can apply: Salaried individuals, Self-employed professionals & Business owners.
  • Property ownership: The property must be legally owned by the borrower.
  • Income proof: Lenders evaluate the borrower's income stability to assess repayment capacity.
  • CIBIL score: A good credit score (typically above 750) increases the chances of approval and better interest rates.

cardData.title: Documents Required
cardData.para:
• Identity proof: Aadhaar, PAN, Passport.
  • Address proof: Aadhaar, Passport, Utility Bills.
  • Income proof: Salary Slips, Bank Statement, ITR, Audited financials.
  • Property documents: Title Deeds, Property Chain documents.

cardData.title: Points to Consider
cardData.para:
• Failure to repay a Loan Against Property can put your property at risk. Use our expert tools to ensure a well-planned and manageable repayment strategy.
  • The approval process may take longer than unsecured loans due to property verification and appraisal.
  • EMIs can impact monthly finances, especially during financial stress. If you're unsure about immediate fund usage, consider an Overdraft Facility for flexible withdrawals.

  • Documents to verify your income and property ownership.

accordions.question: What is the maximum loan amount I can get against my property?
accordions.answer: You can get up to 60-70% of your property’s market value, depending on the lender.

accordions.question: How is my property valued?
accordions.answer: Lenders conduct a thorough valuation based on current market trends and location.

accordions.question: Can I apply for LAP if my property is under a loan?
accordions.answer: Yes, lenders may offer LAP with a balance transfer of the existing loan.

accordions.question: What is the difference between LAP and DOD?
accordions.answer: LAP (Loan Against Property) is a term loan where you get a lump sum amount and repay in fixed EMIs, ideal for long-term needs. DOD (Drop-Line Overdraft) is a flexible credit line where you withdraw as needed, pay interest only on the used amount, and the limit reduces over time. Read more about LAP vs. DOD.

Liability: DigitalDSA is not responsible for any loss, damage, or failure at the user’s end during loan processing. The final decision of the bank or NBFC is binding on both the user and DigitalDSA.
